snippets.name: Databases and sizes
snippets.body: psql -c "SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) FROM pg_database ORDER BY pg_database_size(datname) DESC;"

snippets.name: Active queries
snippets.body: psql -c "SELECT pid, usename, state, now() - query_start AS running, left(query, 80) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY running DESC;"

snippets.name: Locks waiting
snippets.body: psql -c "SELECT pid, wait_event_type, wait_event, left(query, 80) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL;"

snippets.name: Largest tables
snippets.body: psql {{database}} -c "SELECT relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 15;"

snippets.name: Replication status
snippets.body: psql -c "SELECT client_addr, state, sync_state, replay_lag FROM pg_stat_replication;"
